newsitem.title: USA: Alexion says heart product shows promise.
newsitem.headline: Alexion says heart product shows promise.

text.p: Alexion Pharmceuticals Inc said on Friday that its C5 inhibitor drug was reported to block cell death in heart tissue resulting from myocardial infarctions.
Alexion said the preclinical findings were presented here at the annual Vascular Biology meeting by Dr. Gregory Stahl of Harvard Medical School.
Alexion has completed a Phase I safety trial with 5G1.1-SC, its lead complement inhibitor, and this product currently is being tested in a Phase I/II clinical trial.
Alexion, based in New Haven, Conn., develops immunotherapeutic drugs.
